# freshdesk_ticket_form (Resource)

A ticket form shown in the customer portal.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Heading shown above the form in the portal. Must be unique across the helpdesk.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Text shown beneath the form's title.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the form was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the fallback form for new tickets.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the form.
- `name` (String) Internal name of the form. Freshdesk derives it from `title` and does not accept it on a write.
- `updated_at` (String) When the form was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_ticket_form.example 42
```
